newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish IVO sees public listing in late 1997.
newsitem.headline: Finnish IVO sees public listing in late 1997.

text.p: Finnish state-owned power producer Imatran Voima (IVO) is likely to be partly floated late next year, IVO board member and future CEO Heikki Marttinen said on Friday.
"I guess that it will be in the later part of next year... next autumn at the earliest," he told a news conference, asked when IVO's shares could be bought on the Helsinki bourse.

Parliament has authorised the government -- in practice the ministry of trade and industry -- to partly privatise IVO so that the state's ownership does not fall below two thirds (66.7 percent) from 95.6 percent currently.
